description: Schedule a post for a future time, with optional auto-recycle entries (up to 3 reposts and 3 reshares). Scheduled posts publish automatically at their time; when Team Approvals is on, posts submitted by members are held as pending until approved. LinkedIn document posts attach one PDF (≤100 MB, ≤300 pages) as media[].type = "document"; documents are rejected on every other platform. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

account_id.description: A provider account ID from `/accounts`, or a social connection UUID selector.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

payload.description:
Post content. `payload.media` accepts URL objects, objects with `media_id`, or bare media-library UUID strings owned by the selected workspace.
`media[].type` accepts `image`, `video`, `gif`, or `document`, and is resolved from the media-library row when omitted (`application/pdf` → `document`).
LinkedIn document posts attach one PDF (≤100 MB, ≤300 pages) as `media[].type = "document"`; documents on any other platform are rejected with `422`. `media[].title` sets the title LinkedIn shows on the document; without it LinkedIn shows the file name.

media.description: Attachments. Each item is a media-library UUID string, a media URL string, or an object.

anyOf.description: Media-library UUID owned by the workspace, or a publishable media URL.

title.description: Title LinkedIn shows on a document (PDF carousel) post, trimmed, up to 200 characters. Without one, LinkedIn shows the uploaded file name. Also sent as the title of a LinkedIn video; other platforms ignore it.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

offset_seconds.description: Seconds after the source publishes when this recycle fires.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_scheduled_post
title: Create Scheduled Post
